# Klar SaaS landing page (code.in.30s)
Minimal sales-analytics SaaS marketing site. Soft radius (12px), hairline borders, generous whitespace, Inter/Manrope, thin line icons, NO photos, NO emoji, NO neon glows.
## Light: near-white/light-grey. background #F5F5F7, cards #FFFFFF with 1px #E5E7EB hairline borders and very soft shadows, ink #111827, muted #6B7280, ONE indigo accent #4F46E5 (primary button, highlighted pricing plan, chart bars). Secondary soft violet #818CF8 sparingly. Clean medium-weight sans headlines.
